description: This PHP source file defines the RecentSubController class within the Goteo admin controller namespace. It manages recent activity feeds, permissions for access, and provides actions for listing and processing feed data related to administrative recent activities.

classes.name: RecentSubController
classes.description: Controller class for handling recent activity feeds in the admin section, extending AbstractSubController.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to access this controller, allowing only superadmins or root on the master node.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the 'list' action to process and display recent feed items.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Retrieves and returns recent activity feed items based on the specified parameters.
